name: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co.,Ltd
summary: Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells potash fertilizers in China and internationally. It operates through four segments: Potassium Products, Lithium Products, Trading, and Other. The company offers chemical raw materials and chemical products; potassium chloride and other potassium products; lithium carbonate; and fertilizers. It also operates hotels and department stores; and provides labor services. Qinghai Salt Lake Industry Co.,Ltd was founded in 1958 and is based in Golmud, China.
